answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network ties voting power to cryptographic stake burning, requiring an exponential fee scaling as C(n) = k * b^n for n fake identities. A solitary ivory tower agent cannot afford mass identity replication because burning scarce collateral imposes unforgeable economic friction. By anchoring every transaction at the consensus wharf, each burnt deposit emits a genuine cryptographic signal that priced-out adversaries cannot fake.
